The year 2047 is the Viksit Bharat target, not the net zero year.

value: Statements 2 and 3: WMA are short-term RBI advances, introduced in 1997

A State draws SDF first and moves to normal WMA only after exhausting SDF, so statement 3 reverses the order and is wrong.

value: The claim that Amara-Nayaka territories were hereditary and non-transferable is wrong
reasoning: The Amara-Nayaka system was a key political innovation of Vijayanagara, in which military commanders were given territories by the Raya, collected taxes and kept part of the revenue to maintain troops and horses. The Raya could and did transfer them from one place to another, so their territories were not hereditary and non-transferable, which makes D the incorrect statement.
